proposed.explanation: Latex primer lacks salt-spray durability. Oil-based enamel primer is acceptable but epoxy is superior. Universal primer is general-purpose; insufficient for coastal corrosion. Epoxy or specialized rust-inhibiting primer provides superior corrosion protection in salt-air/marine environments. Latex or standard primers offer insufficient salt-spray resistance per ASTM B117. Coastal/marine = epoxy or rust-inhibiting primer mandatory. Freshwater/sheltered = standard primer acceptable. Match primer to environmental exposure.
